summary.text: Todd Pillion is a Republican member of the Senate of Virginia, representing District 6, serving since 2020.
The district covers all of Buchanan, Dickenson, Lee, Russell, Scott, Washington and Wise counties and Bristol City and Norton City.
Todd Pillion served in the House from 2014 to 2020, and the Senate biography lists Todd Pillion's occupation as pediatric dentist.

paragraphs.text: The Senate biography lists a B.A. from Lincoln Memorial University (1996), a D.D.S. from Virginia Commonwealth University School of Dentistry (2001) and a pediatric specialty from the State University of New York at Buffalo (2006).
The memberships entry lists the Virginia Dental Association, the American Academy of Pediatric Dentistry and the American Dental Association.
Todd Pillion serves on the Education and Health; Finance and Appropriations; General Laws and Technology; and Rules committees.
